name: ViaFence
description: Place via fence along selected tracks for EMI shielding
description_full: ViaFence is a KiCad 9 and KiCad 10 Action Plugin that places via fences along selected tracks and arcs for EMI shielding, RF grounding, and improved return-current control. The plugin can follow complex selected copper geometry, including continuous tracks, arcs, T-junctions, multiple branches, and closed loops
